Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for someone with a strong media and advertising foundation; well versed in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Google Campaign Manager, planning, presenting, executing, and optimizing all media strategies.

Our ideal candidate thrives on data and is adept at using it to craft the highest performing campaigns possible. We’re seeking someone who is well organized, attentive to detail, and most importantly is as passionate as the rest of our team is about driving results overnight and building stronger brands over time. Above all, we think having the right positive, engaged personality is crucial for our work culture and to create a passionate tie to our agency’s thriving team philosophy.

Responsibilities

  • Execute data-driven media buying strategies that align with client goals and target audiences.
  • Conduct market research to identify the most effective media channels.
  • Analyze historical campaign data to inform media mix and performance projections.
  • Recommend channel-specific budgets and optimize spend based on performance metrics.
  • Stay current on media trends, platform updates, and emerging technologies, including AI and automation tools.

Campaign Execution & Management

  • Launch, manage, and optimize paid media campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and programmatic display.
  • Monitor real-time campaign performance and proactively adjust bids, budgets, and targeting to improve efficiency and results.
  • Track key KPIs such as leads, cost per acquisition (CPA), cost per lead (CPL), engagement rates, web traffic, and form fills.

Budget Management

  • Manage and allocate media budgets effectively across channels to maximize campaign performance.
  • Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly budget pacing and ensure campaigns remain on schedule and within financial targets.
  • Identify opportunities for cost-saving without compromising campaign effectiveness.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in media buying, preferably in an agency setting or with companies providing B2B services/recruiting to software development firms.
  • Strong experience in paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Ads, programmatic platforms).
  • Proven track record of managing performance marketing campaigns with a focus on results.
  • Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, third-party trackers, etc.)
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Proficiency with media buying and planning tools.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

We are seeking an exceptional Project Manager to join our growing Cloud Project Management team. The right candidate is someone who thrives in a customer-facing environment, is highly organized, and passionate about helping teams deliver meaningful cloud solutions.

  • Develop strong relationships through clear communication and by championing the project experience.

Your Qualifications

Core Consulting Qualifications

Customer Experience

• Proactively identifies and mitigates risks that could impact project success or customer satisfaction.

Collaboration

• Resolves conflicts and escalations with professionalism, balancing delivery realities with customer needs.

Communication
• Navigates challenging conversations, such as scope changes or misaligned expectations, with confidence and clarity.
• Remains composed in unexpected situations, clarifies misunderstandings, and proposes actionable next steps.

Technical Qualifications
• 5+ years of experience in client-facing PM/Scrum role in a technical or consulting environment.
• Managed projects with at least 3+ team members and $250,000+ in budget.
• Strong background in Agile/Scrum delivery and tools (Jira).
• Experience leading engagements in application development, cloud modernization, or data engineering.
• Strong communication and time management skills, with ability to work across technical and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• PMP, CSM, or other Agile/PM certifications.
• Cloud certification (AWS Practitioner or equivalent)

  • Peer bonus awards

  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Experience with automated frontend testing frameworks such as Jest, Cypress, or Testing Library. Strong focus on preventing regressions and maintaining confidence in releases.
  • Cloud Platforms & CI/CD: Familiarity with cloud-hosted frontend environments (e.g., on AWS or GCP) and with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI to support a stable deployment pipeline.

Qualifications

The Well Site Leader of the Future (WSLf) program is a structured program that will include Safety Leadership, Core Technical and Leadership Training to building Core Technical Skills, and Cross-Discipline learning / Broadening with a strong focus on Performance. The program also includes frequent progress reviews that will be used to verify that the WSLf candidates are progressing through the program. The Well Site Leader (WSL) role will support the planning and execution of well construction (drilling and completion), workovers, interventions, and subsea activities in alignment BP’s Who We Are framework, conformance with the requirements of BP’s Operating Management System (OMS), practices and procedures, and with local government regulations. The Well Site Leader of the Future (WSLf) candidate will be responsible for learning and building the vital skills and competencies to function in a Well Site Leader (WSL) role after they have completed (graduated) the program. The base case duration of the program is two to three years. The length of time the candidates spend in the program will depend on the level of skills to build, their pace of learning and the level of experience the candidates bring into the program. Successful candidates will report directly to the Well Superintendent (WSUP). They will work closely with the Well Site Leaders and Supervisors at the well site including all vendors, suppliers, and contractors.

Essential Role Requirements

Experience: Sufficient related well engineering or well operations experience including operator engineering experience. Experience working in and multi-disciplinary teams is helpful. Note: candidates with incremental validated experience will be considered in the selection process.

Qualifications: Communication skills at all levels to be able to optimally learn the skills and competencies associated with the Wellsite Leader role and leading multi-disciplinary scopes of work.

Education: Degree in engineering, science or technical field; Completion of WSLf training program may apply as part of the WSLf role and competency development plan dependent upon the experience of the selected candidates.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities

  • The Development WSL will work as part of a team, under the direction of the Senior Wellsite Leader.

  • Follow the WSLf Program to learn, understand, develop, build skills and competencies in their core technical field including cross-discipline learning.
  • Lead with supervision in well operation activities.

  • Advocate “stop the job” and “speak up culture”.
  • Support the Senior WSL in reporting and documenting HSSE incidents, accidents and process safety events using the bp’s safety reporting system.
  • Support the WSL and well Engineering in all daily operations planning and lookahead forecasts with all onsite vendors, suppliers, and contractors including workload prioritization to allow proper supervision during critical well operations.
  • Leading the maximising Efficiency program to improve operational performance
  • Verify procedural rigor around work done per approved procedures, running operational changes, and site meetings such as pre-job, pre-tour, after action reviews (AAR) and lessons learned (LL) for continuous improvement.

  • Support and lead in contractors, suppliers, and vendors performance for all well operations such as KPI metrics; efficiency – productive, non-productive, and invisible lost time events, investigations, non-conformance; performance feedback.
  • Actively participate in assuring safe operations. Understand and support Stop the Job and speak up culture. Participate in risk assessments and in the event of any activity or program changes.

While Working Onshore

  • Support well planning and learning process through input into drilling procedures, forward programs and active participation in BP’s continuous improvement processes. Participate in Well Program reviews with the Engineering team and ensure onsite lessons are gathered and shared effectively.
  • Management and control of operational costs. Actively pursue cost saving and innovative solutions for well work operations.
  • Develop and demonstrate communication skills in finding opportunities safety improvements and improvements in operational efficiency.
  • Support systematic sharing of takeaways and procedures identified and collected at the rig site.

Key Competencies

  • Core: Personal & Process Safety, Procedures and Practices, OMS, Risk Assessment and Management.

Development & Training

  • CBSP training, water survival and other training as required to obtain approval for travel to the offshore wellsite.
  • Complete and close out gaps identified in WSL competency assessment.
  • Valid Well Control Certificate (WellSharp or IWCF) for Drilling and Well Servicing for Surface and Subsea BOP desirable

Leadership and Behavioural Traits

  • Proactively lives BP’s Who We Are framework, including Code of Conduct
  • Informed Judgment: Uses good practice and sound judgment to deliver safe and driven Well Operations. Knows when to call out appropriate issues or request help. Focus on life-of-well reliability – a key outcome of well construction.
  • Commitment and Engagement: Shows personal commitment to delivering the plan, focused on Continuous Improvement
  • Systematic Management: Progresses operational excellence through systematic application of OMS
  • Leadership Presence: Demonstrates courage to safely handle risk
  • Accountability: Verifying expectations and accountabilities for safety compliance and performance are clear, accepted and delivered
  • Standout Colleague: Interfaces and enables others to realize their fullest potential
  • Safety Leader: Serves as a role model for others
  • Good Communication Skills: Able to connect with individuals of a diverse group of backgrounds, education and social status

Key Relationships

The Development WSL will need to cultivate relationships with the bp well operations team and with the rig contractors and well service personnel supporting the assigned rig. Other key relationships include the Wells Operations team and bp Wells Rigor Team (for engagement in training associated with skill development).

PPFG and geohazard principles for wells, Wellbore geomechanics, Drill string component selection, Drilling operations, Directional drilling, Drilling, Completion & Intervention fluids, Casing design, Tubular handling and installation for wells, Cementing, Drilling data acquisition and well monitoring, Run pressure drilling, Well operations under utmost conditions, Side-track operations, Casing and wellhead recovery, Wellbore fishing operations, Completion tubing design, Completion equipment & accessories, Sand control design, Intelligent Completions, Perforating, Wellbore cleanout, Well testing equipment & operations, Artificial lift, Fracturing and stimulation, Slickline and braided-line, Electric-line, Coiled-tubing, Rig workovers, Through-tubing fishing, Well interventions data acquisition, Subsea control systems for well operations, Completion landing string systems, Open-water riser and riser-less intervention systems, ROV deployment for well operations, Selection and design of subsea equipment, Subsea BOPs, Subsea tree systems, Subsea wellheads, Well control, Well intervention pressure control, Source control for wells, Crisis and emergency response management, Well barrier design, selection and construction, Well barrier operation, monitoring and maintenance, Well reliability. Equipment integrity assurance, Well productivity, Rig and vessel intake and start-up, Rig and vessel operations, Common process for wells activities, OMS and bp requirements, Risk Management, Process Safety Management, Management of Change, Supplier Performance Management, Wells technology delivery, Control of work, Cost management, Digital cybersecurity

  • Extrair, limpar e tratar dados de vendas históricas no ERP/APS.

Requirements and qualifications

  • Noções de finanças e custos operacionais e gestão de estoque.
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Microsoft Excel (Pacote Office) e sistemas ERP como SAP.
  • Estabelecer e manter o princípio de One Number / One Source of Truth, evitando desalinhamentos ou múltiplas versões de dados.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau), Alteryx.

Nice to have

  • Vivência em indústria farmacêutica, Cosmética e Alimentícia;
  • Vivência em processos de S&OP, S&OE ou áreas de planejamento integrado.
  • Pós‑graduação ou MBA em Supply Chain, Planejamento ou Gestão Empresarial
  • Conhecimento no Sistema SAP S/4HANA

Overview

The Company You’ll Join Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence. Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure. Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You\'ll Solve

As we continue expanding beyond Venture Capital into Private Equity markets, we’re building solutions to address the unique challenges of clients managing companies and funds structured as LLCs. These entities vary widely in contractual structures and represent diverse asset classes, requiring a flexible and scalable data model that supports distinct product experiences. Additionally, Private Equity firms, their investors, legal partners, and portfolio companies interact with our platform through different user personas and permissions, making robust access control and tailored experiences essential.

As a Senior Engineer on this team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the next generation of ownership management products. You’ll work closely with product, design, and go-to-market teams—as well as directly with top-tier Private Equity firms and enterprise-scale clients—to deeply understand their needs and deliver high-quality technical solutions.

The Team You\'ll Work With

You’ll be joining our Asset Management LLC Captable team. We launched the Carta LLC product in 2020 and, after discovering a repeatable go-to-market motion, have been on a journey to scale it across the entire portfolio of Private Equity companies. We’re also expanding to support a wide range of ownership management workflows. The scope and impact of each individual on the team are immense. We are biased toward action and believe in the mantra: build → measure → learn. As part of our team, you\'ll work closely with product managers and designers to understand the motivation (why) behind a customer need, define the scope of work (what), and collaborate with your engineering peers to build solutions (how) that deliver meaningful customer value.

About You

You deeply care about your user and are relentless in your pursuit to build delightful user experiences that wow the customer! You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively who can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype. Additionally,

  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business and marketing.
  • You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You see communication as one of your strengths.
  • You want to build and own your work end-to-end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.

The Interview Process

Carta follows a standard tech startup interview process, where you will meet with a recruiter and hiring manager first. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real-world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode-style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly-linked list) and virtual interviews. During the process, you can ask questions to people across different parts of the Fund Administration team to learn what kind of work we do and how it lines up with your interests.

About Us

At Félix, we're building the financial ecosystem for Latin immigrants in the U.S., starting with a revolution in remittances. Our core product is an AI-powered chatbot built on WhatsApp, allowing our users to send money home as easily as sending a text message. We leverage cutting-edge technology like AI, blockchain, and stablecoins to make cross-border payments faster, more affordable, and more accessible than ever before.

We are a hyper-growth Series B company, backed by over $100 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, and General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, the Félix founders were selected as “Endeavour Entrepreneurs” and were recipients of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award. We are a group of extremely talented and dedicated high-performers, united by our shared obsession with a single goal: empowering our customers. We are all owners of Félix, driven by a bias for action and a true experimentation spirit to get things done with urgency and focus.

Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long. We are a team that is fiercely loyal to each other, where radical transparency and constructive feedback are how we grow and push for excellence. We are bold, we care less about what others are doing, and more about creating sustainable value and a product that truly makes our users' lives better. We are building the future, today.

This role is open to all candidates in Latin America.

About the Role

As a key member of our engineering team, you will have a unique opportunity to shape the core technology behind our chat-driven platform. You will work on Felix Pago’s Chat Platform — a sophisticated system that not only processes high volumes of transactions but also delivers conversational experiences through integrated chatbots and natural language interfaces. Your role will be crucial in designing and enhancing interactive chat services that enable seamless, intuitive user interactions on platforms like WhatsApp. If you have experience building chatbots or crafting conversational experiences, this is your chance to make a significant impact.

Technology Stack:

  • We are technology agnostic and value candidates with diverse backgrounds. While familiarity with the following is helpful, your willingness to learn and adapt is paramount:
  • Front-end: React, HTTP, HTML/DOM, JavaScript, CSS, AJAX
  • Back-end: Python, Flask/FastAPI, REST APIs, Redis, SQL, gRPC
  • Cloud: Google Cloud services (Firestore, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Google Artifact Registry, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, etc.)
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Terraform, NewRelic, PagerDuty

Responsibilities:

  • Design & Architecture: Architect and implement high-performance, scalable backend microservices, including core components of our Chat Platform.
  • Conversational Interfaces: Build, deploy, and iterate on chatbot services and conversational interfaces that empower users to interact naturally with our remittance services.
  • Infrastructure: Design and manage infrastructure capable of handling millions of daily requests with real-time messaging capabilities.
  • Web Development: Utilize web development technologies to build user-facing applications that integrate seamlessly with our chat-based solutions.
  • Cloud Integration: Develop backend services using established industry standards and Google Cloud services.
  • Collaboration & Mentorship: Foster the growth of junior developers through mentorship and best practice implementation, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including product, UX/UI, and business units.
  • Continuous Improvement: Leverage customer feedback and analytics to iterate and improve our conversational experience, ensuring that our chatbots remain effective and user-friendly.
  • Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level or higher is required.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to build, ship, and iterate on software applications with an emphasis on real-world impact.
  • Strong foundation in algorithms and data structures.
  • Experience with web services, including SOAP and REST APIs.
  • Familiarity with architectural patterns like Hexagonal Architecture, Event Driven Architecture, A/B Testing, Feature Flags, and Gradual Rollouts.
  • Conversational Experience: Demonstrated experience in building chatbots, conversational interfaces, or integrating natural language processing (NLP) tools. Familiarity with chatbot frameworks (e.g., DialogFlow, IBM Watson, Rasa) is a plus.
  • Passion for building products that positively impact millions.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and exploration of new technologies.
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative environment and contribute actively with innovative ideas.
  • Excellent prioritization skills.
  • Curiosity and/or experience in Fintech is an added advantage (though equivalent competencies will also be considered).

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Initial stock options grant
  • Annual performance bonus
  • Health, dental, and vision plans
  • Remote work environment, although we have offices in Miami and México City and would love to work in hybrid model if you are up to it.
  • Continuous learning opportunities
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid parental leave
  • Empowering opportunities for growth in a dynamic entrepreneurial environment

title: Director of Finance, Real Estate and Capital Asset Development
description:
Overview

Director of Finance, Real Estate and Capital Asset Development

Be among the first 25 applicants. Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

The Director of Real Estate Finance plays a pivotal leadership role in the financial planning, investment strategy, and execution of complex real estate transactions within the Real Estate Development and Capital Asset Management (REDCAM) portfolio. Reporting to the Vice President and Chief Real Estate Officer, this role is responsible for guiding financial strategy for student housing, commercial development, acquisitions, ground leases, and joint ventures in support of the University’s strategic mission.

This position requires advanced financial acumen, a deep understanding of institutional real estate, and the ability to lead through highly complex development initiatives in alignment with the University’s strategic plan and the approved Campus Master Plan. The Director oversees financial analysis, long range capital planning, transaction structuring, and performance monitoring to ensure the portfolio supports institutional goals, adheres to risk parameters, and maintains financial sustainability. Additionally, the Director must create and support an environment that fosters teamwork, leadership development, integrity, and service responsiveness, while effectively managing relationships with business partners, regulatory agencies, and internal and external stakeholders.

Supervisory Accountability

The incumbent is responsible for overseeing the successful completion of projects, and is therefore expected to ensure all contributing parties remain on task, on time, and on budget. While this position does not have formal direct reports, the Director leads cross-functional deal teams composed of analysts, external advisors, consultants, and university stakeholders.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include executives, administrators, faculty, students, and staff of the university at large.

External contacts include housing partners, investors and lenders, consultants, contractors, local regulatory agencies, historical societies, local surrounding communities, representatives from other colleges and universities, visitors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

Financial Analysis and Reporting

  • Conduct comprehensive financial analyses and prepare reports to assess key performance indicators and operational efficiencies.

Strategic Financial Planning

  • Long-term financial planning for the University’s real estate portfolio that anticipates and responds to legislative changes affecting higher education specifically. Develop scenario based financial models and sensitivity analysis in coordination with the Office of Data Analytics and External Affairs that incorporate potential regulatory changes, mitigate risk, and capitalize on new opportunities.

Budgeting And Forecasting

  • Support the budgeting process, implementing financial models for accurate forecasting.

Investment And Strategic Planning And Analysis

  • Support pre-transaction analysis and due diligence, including financial modeling and pro forma analysis, cost-benefit or return on investment analysis, feasibility analysis, market research, and review of third party reports such as market demand studies, environmental assessments, appraisals, facility assessment reports, among others.
  • Evaluate new investment opportunities and support the development of strategies for long-term needs and uses of the University’s real property assets including acquisitions, development, leasing, and disposition of assets.
  • Review all real estate agreements, documents, and contracts working with the Office of General Counsel to ensure compliance with the university strategic plans and procedures, and compliance with pertinent District of Columbia and Maryland laws, as applicable.

Project Support

  • Provide financial guidance to enhance property management financial efficiency and cost control. Provides support for a portfolio of real estate projects, entailing development, construction, property management, legal, and financial components.

Stakeholder Communication

  • Prepare and clearly communicate transaction analysis, financial data and strategies to university stakeholders, regarding structure, economics, mission benefits, progress, etc.

Academic Collaboration

  • Works collaboratively with the offices of the Chief Financial Officer and other members of the Administrative Services Leadership Team.

Presentation Support

  • Support the preparation of RFQ/RFP responses for all bids, ensuring compliance to policy and procedure, including zoning laws and securing public approval.
  • Preparation of materials and presentations for the Facilities and Real Estate Committee and the Board of Trustees.

Administrative Support

  • Provide administrative support as needed, including contract review and revision in coordination with outside counsel, and tracking and managing project budgets. Oversee these functions through to completion, ensuring compliance with all University processes and procedures.

Perform other related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

Analytical and Strategic Thinking

  • Ability to perform complex financial underwriting, and conduct complex structuring including joint ventures, development, and debt instruments.
  • Knowledge of underwriting and closing debt and equity transactions locally, regionally, and nationally.
  • Must possess advanced analytical skills in evaluating real estate transactions.
  • Ability to gather and thoroughly analyze information in order to make well-founded recommendations to the University’s Senior Administration.

Communication, Organizational, And Interpersonal Skills

  • Demonstrate the ability to use sound judgment and to be an effective decision maker.
  • Ability to convey complex financial information clearly and build strong relationships with university and external stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage a transaction pipeline.
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, verbal, and analytical skills.
  • Ability to establish and maintain harmonious work relationships with students, staff, faculty, University officials, and the general public.
  • Ability to develop knowledge of, respect for, and skills to engage with those of other cultures or backgrounds is required.

Innovation And Problem-Solving

  • Creative approach to improving financial performance and operational processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to multi-task; to be a team player; and to be flexible and adaptable to change.

Technology Proficiency

  • Proven strength in the use of spreadsheets, database, and presentation applications, including Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Demonstrated proficiency in financial modeling and analysis tools.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Real Estate, Economics, or related field
  • MBA with a concentration in Finance, Real Estate, or related field
  • Minimum 12-15 years of related work experience, including real estate focused banking, development, finance, underwriting, structured finance, fundamental credit analysis, consulting, urban planning, and/or public policy; including experience with institutional or public-sector projects.
  • CFA or CAIA candidate status is strongly preferred.
  • 15 years of related work experience may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications.
  • Strong analytical, financial modeling, and reporting skills.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and project management abilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and financial software.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure
$120,000 - $130,000

  • Director

  • Full-time

  • Industries: Online Audio and Video Media

Significant well operations experience, with sufficient experience working at the well site in a supervisory position. Experience working in and preferably supervising multi-disciplinary teams.

Qualifications

  • Excellent social skills with the ability to communicate at all levels to effectively manage multi-disciplinary scopes of work.
  • Successfully completed or undertake a WSL competency assessment.
  • Valid Well Control Certificate (WellSharp or IWCF).
  • BOSIET or HUET training for locations requiring helicopter transit to the Wellsite.
  • Education: Minimum of a High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • Desirable Education: Degree in engineering, science or technical field.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities

  • The WSL establishes the leadership culture—setting priorities and ensuring they are understood at site inductions, daily meetings and pre-job meetings.
  • BP’s lead representative on a well site, primarily leading a team of contract workers, assuring procedural subject area is followed.
  • Accountable for running daily operations planning, ensuring the plan is understood, communicated to onsite senior contractor representatives, cascaded to personnel performing the work, and fully understood.
  • Contributes to well planning and learning processes through input into drilling procedures, forward programmes and BP’s continuous improvement processes; participates in Well Program reviews with the Engineering team and ensures onsite lessons are gathered and shared effectively.
  • Management and control of operational costs; actively pursue cost saving and innovative solutions for well work operations.
  • Ensures site safety and environment management systems are implemented as designed and are consistent with BP’s policies and standards.
  • Responsible for data accuracy in morning reports (NPT and operational coding) to ensure accurate performance reporting.
  • Leads BP’s task-level self-verification and Contractor oversight checks at the Wellsite.
  • Stops the job and assesses risk for any program changes or changes to risk mitigation barriers; informs the Wellsite Update Point (WSUP) of changes to the risk profile.
  • Ensures Well Control procedures are understood and implemented by the Wellsite team.
  • Leads planning, coordination and prioritization of materials and logistics to and from the Wellsite.
  • Verifies awareness and conformance to Well Control and SMS Bridging documents with Wellsite teams.
  • Owns initiatives to maximize efficiency by measuring performance and implementing improvement opportunities.

Onshore Working Context

  • Commitment to well planning and learning processes; participates in Well Program reviews with the Engineering team and shares onsite lessons.
  • Demonstrates strong communication skills to identify opportunities for operational efficiency, emerging risks, and safety concerns.
  • Systematically shares takeaways and procedures across teams and rig lines.

Key Competencies

  • Core: Personal & Process Safety, Procedures and Practices, OMS, Risk Assessment and Management.
  • Subject area: Life of Well Design, Equipment Integrity Assurance, Well Integrity, Well Control, Well Performance, Slick Line, Electric Line, Coil Tubing, Tubular Handling, Cementing, Drill String Handling, Wellhead and Tree Installation, Directional Drilling and Surveying techniques.

Development & Training

  • Close out gaps identified in WSL competency assessment.
  • Provide support and coaching to ensure safe and efficient execution of activities.
  • Mentor and supervise the development of less experienced WSLs and engineering staff on the rigsite.

Leadership and Behavioural Traits

  • Proactively lives BP values, including Code of Conduct.
  • Informed Judgment: uses good practice and sound judgment to deliver safe, reliable Well Operations.
  • Commitment and Engagement: demonstrates personal commitment to delivering the plan and Continuous Improvement.
  • Systematic Management: progresses operational excellence through OMS.
  • Leadership Presence: demonstrates courage to safely manage risk.
  • Accountability: ensures safety compliance and performance expectations are clear and delivered.
  • Great Teammate: enables others to reach their potential.
  • Safety Leader: serves as a role model for others.
  • Good Communication: able to communicate with diverse individuals.

Key Relationships

The Senior WSL will cultivate relationships with Engineering Teams, contractors and well service personnel in the field, as well as Well planning service providers, Wells Operations, Logistics, the New Well Delivery team, the Resource team, Drilling Engineering, Completions Engineering, Interventions, and Integrity teams. bp is committed to diversity and an inclusive environment. Overview

Local de trabalho: Around São Paulo, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná, and/or Santa Catarina

Regime: Remote

Você ama chocolate? Agora imagina trabalhar com essa gostosura!

Responsibilities

  • Reportando-se a Gerente de Trade Marketing, o Analista de Trade Marketing Canal Sr será responsável por desenvolver e implementar estratégias de trade marketing para a praça do estado de São Paulo, com uma perspectiva entre canais, visando aumentar a visibilidade da Hershey no ponto de venda e impulsionar o sell-out.
  • Desenvolvimento e execução de planos de trade marketing para todos os canais da praça de São Paulo, exceto Key Accounts.
  • Análise de dados de mercado e de vendas para identificação de oportunidades de crescimento.
  • Colaboração com equipes de vendas e marketing para alinhar estratégias e objetivos.
  • Gestão do orçamento de trade marketing e garantir a eficiência dos investimentos.
  • Monitoramento e avaliação da performance das campanhas de trade marketing.
  • Relacionamento com parceiros de canal e negociação de ações promocionais.
  • Elaboração de relatórios e apresentações de resultados para a alta gestão.

Qualifications

  • Graduação superior completa;
  • Atuação anterior na área de Trade Marketing Canal, em indústrias de FMCG;
  • Experiência na região / mercado de São Paulo e conhecimento sólido nos principais canais de distribuição (indireto e direto);
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel e Power Point;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de sell-out como Neogrid, Scanntech, Kantar e/ou Nielsen;
  • Habilidade analítica, capacidade de interpretar dados de mercado e identificação de oportunidades;
  • Perfil proativo com boa comunicação e relacionamento entre áreas / clientes;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em São Paulo, São Paulo, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná, and/or Santa Catarina
  • Formato remoto e com disponibilidade para viajar 20%
  • Inglês ou Espanhol intermediários serão considerados diferenciais.

Detalhes do dia a dia

  • Desenvolvimento e execução de planos de trade marketing para todos os canais da praça de São Paulo, exceto Key Accounts;
  • Análise de dados de mercado e de vendas para identificação de oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Colaboração com equipes de vendas e marketing para alinhar estratégias e objetivos;
  • Gestão do orçamento de trade marketing e garantir a eficiência dos investimentos;
  • Monitoramento e avaliação da performance das campanhas de trade marketing;
  • Relacionamento com parceiros de canal e negociação de ações promocionais;

description:
SUPERVISOR OPERAÇÕES LEVES ( AEROPORTO SANTOS DUMONT/RJ)

Unidas Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Resumo da vaga
Unidas, integrante do grupo Brookfield, é uma das maiores empresas do setor de mobilidade no Brasil. Conta com cerca de 100 mil ativos entre veículos leves, caminhões, máquinas e equipamentos pesados, e oferece uma plataforma completa de soluções de gestão e locação de veículos, operações e manutenção, trazendo economia e praticidade para pessoas e empresas em todo o país. A companhia tem mais de 4 mil colaboradores e é reconhecida como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil pelo Great Place to Work. Também já foi eleita a 32ª marca mais valiosa pelo Brand Finance Brazil e, por sete vezes, conquistou o Prêmio Consumidor Moderno de Excelência em Serviço ao Cliente na categoria “Locadora de veículos”.

Empoderamos as pessoas do nosso time e investimos no aprendizado diário e desenvolvimento contínuo. Aqui, cada Unilover é responsável por sua carreira e a leva para onde quiser.

Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar o time de analistas de operações, garantindo a máxima disponibilidade dos carros para as lojas da Rede RAC obedecendo a um rigoroso padrão de qualidade (conservação, manutenção, limpeza e abastecimento) e de acordo com a demanda diária/futura.
  • Garantir o engajamento da equipe para disponibilizar veículos com qualidade dentro do padrão Unidas.
  • Garantir escala e gestão da equipe para atendimento aos clientes, organização e funcionamento correto das lojas.
  • Garantir que as cobranças de reembolsáveis sejam realizadas dentro da meta pré-definida.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Desejáveis conhecimentos de gestão em transportadoras, concessionárias, frotas e/ou locadoras.

Informações adicionais

  • Convênio Médico;
  • Convênio Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação;
  • Cartão Farmácia;
  • WellHub;
  • Clube de Vantagens;
  • Carro da empresa;
  • Cartão flex;
  • Programa de Lucros e Resultados.

Sobre a Unidas

Na Unidas, carreira é jornada, não destino. Somos um dos maiores grupos do Brasil no setor de mobilidade e terceirização de frotas, com soluções que vão de veículos leves a pesados, passando por máquinas e equipamentos. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo, o aprendizado diário e o empoderamento individual. Acreditamos que cada talento pode transformar realidades e oferecemos as ferramentas, o ambiente e os desafios certos para isso acontecer. Somos parte de algo maior: integrados ao portfólio Brookfield Asset Management, uma das maiores gestoras de ativos do mundo, com visão de longo prazo e compromisso com o desenvolvimento sustentável.

Seja bem-vindo(a)! A Unidas é o seu caminho para crescer, aprender, inovar e fazer parte de uma história de transformação. Aqui sua carreira tem direção, propósito e movimento.

title: Supervisor (a) de Produção - Programa de Desenvolvimento Acelerado
description:
Supervisor (a) de Produção - Programa de Desenvolvimento Acelerado

Key Expected Achievements

  1. Member of the Operations team: the Business Unit Leader aspires to drive the performance of the Shop first, even before their own Business Unit. For this, they are actively involved in:
    • a. Sharing best practices between Business Units and helping to contribute to the Plant performance in a collaborative manner. We maintain a mindset of “ONE MANUFACTURING TEAM” in all situations.
    • b. Detecting & developing talents that will grow their career in the Shop. They develop and export talent from their Business Unit to other activities to support business needs.
    • c. Supporting Shop decisions even when uncertainty and unfavorable circumstances may impact their own Business Unit.
    • d. Improve the performance of the Business Unit through regular coaching and feedback of support team members.
    • e. Provide input on the performance of support team members as well as recommendations for development.
  2. People developer: the Business Unit Leader is animated with the passion for people development, seeing their plant as a platform to recruit, train & offer professional growth for everyone in their teams. The Business Unit Leader is expected to:
    • a. Deploy a life-long learning mindset in the teams, through evaluation of competencies and identifying development opportunities to close the gaps.
    • b. Ensure the development of people through the avenue of Spoke training by support teams or through social promotion projects.
    • c. Utilize career paths accessible for all their employees.
    • d. Build and believe in the value of diverse teams.
    • e. Support competency development through mentoring & coaching.
  3. Representative/Role model of the Company values, purpose & strategy: the Business Unit Leader represents the Plant for the employees. They embody the group values by:
    • a. Consistently living out the values and acting as an example to inspire their employees by their behaviors.
    • b. Motivating their teams by leveraging the Michelin purpose & Dream.
    • c. Making sure that everyone in their Team understands the Plant strategy and understands the role that they play in the collective success of the vision.

title: Gerente de Transfer Pricing
description:
Inclusão e respeito à diversidade e equidade fazem parte do DNA da KPMG.

Aqui valorizamos todas as pessoas, encorajando e empoderando os nossos profissionais para que se sintam parte das nossas conquistas.

Independente da sua idade, gênero, raça, cor, credo, orientação, sexual, etnia, origem nacional ou deficiência, te convidamos a fazer a diferença. Venha fazer parte do time KPMG!

  • Fazemos o que é certo #Integrity
  • Aprendemos e nos aprimoramos #Excellence
  • Pensamos e agimos de maneira arrojada #Courage
  • Respeitamos uns aos outros e nos fortalecemos com nossas diferenças #Together
  • Fazemos o que realmente importa #For Better

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Caso seja aprovado(a), você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Instruir o cliente em relação aos impactos das mudanças nas regras de preços de transferência, alinhadas com as diretrizes da OCDE;
  • Avaliar o impacto financeiro das mudanças nas regras de preços de transferência, alinhado com as diretrizes da OCDE para as operações do cliente;
  • Aplicação das novas regras de preços de transferência às transações intercompany referentes ao negócio;
  • Análise funcional para identificação do perfil da entidade, bem como para delinear as transações intercompany e os respectivos métodos de transfer pricing;
  • Simulação de impactos financeiros, indicativa dos preços de transferência, tendo como base a Demonstração de Resultados do Exercício (DRE);
  • Análise econômica e de comparabilidade para fins de determinar o preço a ser praticado, considerando o indicador financeiro, o método mais apropriado e o intervalo interquartil mais apropriado;
  • Preparo de documentação de preços de transferência, incluindo arquivo local, arquivo global e ECF, bem como documentação de suporte;
  • Auxílio na preparação de acordos de preços de transferência e interfaces com regras de tributação internacional;
  • Análise dos rendimentos e das transações controladas para fins de tributação no Brasil (imposto de renda, PIS, COFINS etc.).

Requisitos e qualificações

O que procuramos em você?

  • Formação em: Direito, Economia, Contabilidade, Finanças e áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em: Tributação Internacional, incluindo o entendimento dos princípios contábeis internacionais.
  • Experiência em: preços de transferência de acordo com as diretrizes da OCDE, incluindo a aplicação de métodos de preços de transferência, cálculos de benchmarking, análise de indicadores econômicos e conhecimento de modelos de negócios e setores diversificados, preparo e revisão de documentação de preços de transferência e análise de riscos fiscais.
  • Conhecimento de tributação internacional e de tributação da renda, especialmente em aplicação de tratados internacionais, diretrizes da OCDE, projeto BEPS, legislação fiscal doméstica e direito comparado.
  • Experiência em análise de dados e modelagem financeira, incluindo a utilização de ferramentas de análise de dados para identificar tendências e padrões.
  • Habilidade em comunicação e apresentação, incluindo a capacidade de explicar conceitos complexos de preços de transferência de forma clara e persuasiva.
  • Habilidade em gestão de projetos, incluindo a capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e cumprir prazos.
  • Conhecimento em negociação, incluindo a capacidade de negociar acordos de preços antecipados (APA) e resolver disputas fiscais.
  • Habilidade em liderança, incluindo a capacidade de liderar equipes e fornecer orientação e treinamento para outros profissionais de transfer pricing.
  • Necessário inglês fluente.
  • Residir no Rio de Janeiro ou Belo Horizonte.

Quais as vantagens de ser KPMG?

  • Aqui atuamos com as mais novas tecnologias;
  • Nossos profissionais são referência no mercado;
  • Somos uma das maiores empresas de prestação de serviço do mundo;

Quais benefícios oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Incentivo a Graduação
  • Incentivo à Idiomas
  • Subsídio de Órgão de Classe
  • Licença Maternidade extendida
  • Jornada de Trabalho Flexível
  • Meu Tempo: até 6 dias inteiros por ano — ou 12 meios períodos — para você fazer uma pausa, cuidar de si e usar como quiser, quando precisar.

title: Head of Product Growth, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $400,000/year USD
description:
Head of Product Growth, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $400,000/year USD

Head of Product Growth, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $400,000/year USD role at Trilogy.

This range is provided by Trilogy. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

$200.00/hr - $200.00/hr

Overview

Ready to revolutionize education through AI? We are seeking a visionary product strategist to spearhead our Education vertical and champion a mission that matters: helping students learn more effectively through personalized instruction. This isn\'t about incremental improvements—it's about fundamentally reimagining how education works.

As our Head of Product Growth, you\'ll craft the strategic blueprint that unifies our educational offerings into a cohesive ecosystem. You\'ll author our definitive "Brain Lift" strategy document and translate it into actionable roadmaps that make our products work in harmony. This player-coach role requires you to dive deep into critical work while guiding a talented team of Product Owners toward measurable impact.

We\'re challenging the status quo of one-size-fits-all education by building a system rooted in learning science and AI that adapts to each student\'s unique needs. Our mission is proving that education can be simultaneously personalized and powerful.

This position diverges from conventional product leadership roles. Success here isn\'t measured by process management or delegation skills, but by your ability to drive tangible outcomes through first-principles thinking, analytical rigor, and unwavering determination.

Working directly with founders and leading a sharp team, your ultimate metric is straightforward: demonstrable evidence that your strategy has meaningfully enhanced student learning outcomes. If you\'re energized by accountability and eager to tackle education\'s most significant challenges, we should connect.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Craft and Evolve the Strategic Framework: Develop and continuously refine the comprehensive "Education Domain BrainLift"—a living strategic document that synthesizes team insights, market intelligence, and learning science into a unified vision guiding the entire vertical.
  • Orchestrate Portfolio Development: Transform strategic vision into an outcome-focused roadmap that coordinates all products within our ecosystem. You\'ll determine the strategic sequencing that maximizes compounding value and provides the "why" behind every initiative.
  • Lead Through Action and Mentorship: Serve as both strategist and practitioner—running your own rapid OODA (Observe-Orient-Decide-Act) loops on mission-critical objectives while elevating your team through thoughtful review and strategic guidance to ensure cohesive execution across the portfolio.

What You Won’t Be Doing

  • Functioning solely as a people manager. While leadership is essential, your value comes from strategic direction and execution standards, not administrative oversight of headcount and budgets.
  • Implementing predetermined strategies. You won\'t be executing someone else\'s vision—you\'ll be crafting the comprehensive strategy yourself, building it from first principles and ground-level insights.
  • Maintaining rigid, unchanging roadmaps. Your portfolio strategy will evolve continuously, incorporating weekly learnings and adapting to new discoveries from your team\'s work and your own investigations.
  • Managing disconnected feature development. Success isn\'t measured by feature quantity but by strategic outcomes that create synergy across products, breaking down silos to deliver unified educational experiences.

Basic Requirements

  • 6+ years in product leadership positions where you personally developed product vision and owned fundamental problem-solution hypotheses
  • Proven track record launching at least one successful product from conception to market—specifically a complete product (not just features) that reached external users and generated minimum $1M in revenue
  • Demonstrated proficiency integrating AI tools into your professional workflow (analysis, research, strategy development, information synthesis)

About LearnWith.AI

LearnWith.AI is an edtech startup that leverages AI and subject matter experts to cultivate a new way of learning. Our unique approach leverages 50+ years of learning science, cutting-edge data analytics and AI-powered coaching. In doing so, we can help students learn more, learn faster, and learn better - and have fun while doing it. We are a remote-first company that hires globally via Crossover.

Working with us

This is a full-time (40 hours per week), long-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $200 USD/hour, which equates to $400,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult for more details on this topic.

Temos 4 unidades físicas, localizadas em Duque de Caxias, Centro do Rio e Ilha do Governador. Dessas, 3 unidades possuem atendimento ao público, com consultórios médicos, salas de audiometria, coleta de sangue, psicóloga e demais exames complementares (Eletrocardio, Eletroencefalo, Acuidade, Espirometria e Toxicológico).

As empresas possuem entre 2 a 30 anos de existência no mercado, com uma abrangente cartela de clientes nos municípios do Rio, Duque de Caxias e outras cidades do Rio e em outros Estados.

Objetivo Do Cargo

Atuar como ponto de acolhimento e atendimento ao público na unidade médica, com foco em excelência no atendimento bilíngue, organização dos fluxos administrativos e apoio às demandas operacionais da clínica, assegurando uma experiência positiva aos clientes e o bom andamento das rotinas clínicas.

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar atendimento presencial, telefônico e por e-mail;
  • Garantir o acolhimento humanizado e eficiente aos pacientes, visitantes e fornecedores;
  • Coordenar a recepção de exames, encaminhamento para consultórios e suporte ao fluxo de atendimento médico;
  • Zelar pela imagem institucional da empresa com postura ética e apresentação impecável;
  • Apoiar na triagem documental e na organização de prontuários e registros médicos;
  • Informar e orientar sobre procedimentos e serviços realizados na clínica.

Atividades Do Dia a Dia

  • Recepcionar os pacientes e realizar o check-in dos atendimentos;
  • Atualizar cadastros e conferir documentações necessárias para os exames;
  • Controlar a agenda de atendimentos e organizar a fila de chamada;
  • Atender ligações telefônicas e responder e-mails;
  • Auxiliar nos processos de agendamento e encaminhamento de exames ocupacionais;
  • Realizar conferência de guias, autorizações e documentos enviados pelas empresas clientes;
  • Apoiar na organização e conservação do ambiente da recepção.

Requisitos mínimos

  • Formação superior completa ou cursando (Administração, Secretariado, Letras ou áreas afins);
  • Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência em clínicas de medicina do trabalho;
  • Conhecimento em atendimento ao cliente e rotinas administrativas clínicas;
  • Fácil acesso ao Centro do Rio de Janeiro;
  • Domínio do pacote Office (Word, Excel e Outlook).

Habilidades Necessárias

  • Comunicação verbal e escrita clara e profissional;

  • Capacidade de lidar com múltiplas tarefas simultaneamente;

Competências Comportamentais Fundamentais

  • Discrição e ética no trato com informações confidenciais;

description:
Resumo

Gerente de Novos Negócios e Produtos na LIV - Laboratório Inteligência de Vida

Quem somos

Aqui no LIV, entendemos que os sentimentos são partes essenciais para a aprendizagem, e promovemos um aprendizado socioemocional de qualidade para todos. Buscamos pessoas que se identifiquem com o nosso propósito e que queiram impactar comunidades escolares de todo o Brasil.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estratégia e Novos Negócios
    • Pesquisa de mercado e benchmark de concorrentes
    • Estruturação e análise de novos modelos de negócio
    • Modelagem financeira e de cenários (DCF, projeções, etc.)
    • Preparação e apresentação em fóruns estratégicos (diretoria e liderança executiva)
    • Avaliação de potenciais novos produtos e parcerias
  • Planejamento e Orçamento
    • Desdobramento de orçamento em áreas/projetos
    • Acompanhamento e controle do dia a dia (despesas, receitas, capex/opex)
    • Análise de variações orçamentárias e desenhos de mudança de rota
  • Gestão de Produto e Operação
    • Atividades comerciais (apoio em vendas, relacionamento com clientes/parceiros)
    • Acompanhamento e análise da operação (indicadores, metas, resultados)
    • Definição de melhorias e soluções para problemas operacionais
    • Liderança de equipe (time de 7 pessoas, gestão de entregas, priorização e desenvolvimento)
  • Desenvolvimento de Novos Produtos/Portfólio
    • Pesquisa e análise de viabilidade de potenciais novos produtos
    • Construção de business cases e projeções para expansão do portfólio
    • Suporte à decisão sobre investimento em novos projetos

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Pensamento estratégico e visão sistêmica
  • Capacidade analítica e raciocínio estruturado
  • Tomada de decisão com base em dados
  • Clareza na comunicação (oral e escrita, inclusive para fóruns executivos)
  • Liderança e gestão de pessoas
  • Adaptabilidade e aprendizado rápido em novos contextos
  • Proatividade e iniciativa para propor soluções
  • Colaboração com diferentes áreas (comercial, pedagógico, TI, financeiro etc.)
  • Resiliência e capacidade de lidar com pressão e alta demanda

Informações adicionais

Por que escolher ser LIVástico?

Nós oferecemos:

  • Vale-Refeição ou Vale-Alimentação (você decide como dividir)
  • Vale-Transporte
  • Gympass, para te ajudar a ficar em dia com a sua saúde
  • Dress code descontraído
  • Day off no mês do aniversário
  • Uma sexta-feira off por mês (ou um dia de folga por mês, a ser alinhado com a gestão da área)
  • Plano de carreira: queremos te ver voando com a gente!
  • Acreditamos que um time diverso é o caminho para cumprir a nossa missão de transformar vidas e o Brasil. Incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas que se identifiquem com grupos minorizados em todas as nossas posições.

Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Responsabilidades

  • Pacote Microsoft Office.

title: General Manager
description:
Overview

Fairmont Hotels is a globally renowned luxury brand, celebrated for creating unforgettable memories for our guests. With more than 30,000 colleagues worldwide, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional service, embracing innovation, and fostering a culture of excellence.

Hotel Overview

Perched on the world-famous Copacabana Beach, the Fairmont Copacabana is one of Rio de Janeiro’s most prestigious luxury addresses and a symbol of the city’s glamorous lifestyle. With 375 rooms and suites, many offering panoramic views of the ocean and Sugar Loaf Mountain, the hotel blends timeless elegance with the vibrant energy of Rio.

As a leading destination for both leisure and business travelers, the hotel boasts extensive meeting and event spaces, hosting everything from high-profile international conferences to glamorous weddings and social gatherings. With its enviable beachfront location, modern design infused with local culture, and a legacy of warm Brazilian hospitality, the Fairmont Copacabana embodies the art de vivre of Fairmont while standing as an icon of Rio de Janeiro’s luxury hotel scene.

Job Description

As the General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana , you will embody the essence of luxury hospitality. Your dynamic and hands-on approach is fueled by a deep passion for developing people and fostering an entrepreneurial spirit. A true brand and guest ambassador, you will challenge conventions, consistently seek solutions, and infuse innovation into every facet of the hotel experience and every function of the business.

Your seasoned leadership style will blend diplomacy with relationship-building prowess, cultivating strong connections with both internal and external stakeholders, including Owners and the Community. Your ability to engage with ownership and strategize revenue enhancements will be coupled with an innate talent for envisioning the hotel's long-term trajectory.

A refined sense of finance and business acumen will be at the core of your decision-making, grounded in an unwavering commitment to delivering a world-class product and service. By seamlessly weaving local heritage and culture into our offerings, you will not only create an authentic guest experience but also drive excellence across all dimensions of our operations.

In your role as a catalyst for exceptional service, you will uphold the highest standards, infusing every interaction with the kind of genuine care that leaves an indelible mark on our guests. Nurturing an environment of continuous growth and skill development, you will inspire our colleagues to consistently exceed expectations, turning moments into memories for every visitor.

As a visionary leader, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our strategic direction. Your involvement in goal setting and objective communication will propel business growth and solidify the hotel’s reputation as a distinguished luxury destination. Your ability to foster positive relationships with ownership will ensure a harmonious partnership that aligns with our overarching strategy while enhancing the hotel's performance and prestige.

Your leadership will be synonymous with setting industry benchmarks and redefining luxury hospitality. Your commitment to excellence, coupled with your innovative approach, will leave an enduring mark on our iconic brand and create a legacy of unparalleled guest memories.

Reporting Structure

The General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana will report to the Cluster Delegate Manager for Rio de Janeiro Luxury Hotels , as part of the unique cluster structure that unites Accor’s flagship luxury properties in the city.

Qualifications

Key Behaviours and Responsibilities:

  1. 1. Act with an open mindset:

    Embrace innovative ideas, adapt to change, and encourage a culture of innovation and continuous learning. Demonstrate explicit knowledge and awareness of company standards as an integral role model. Build quality relationships with the management team. Create an environment that encourages innovation, challenges traditional thinking, and fosters a "speak-up" culture.

  2. 2. Create positive impact working with others:

    Foster an inclusive and collaborative work environment, empowering colleagues to contribute their best and building strong relationships based on trust and respect. Create a collaborative and inclusive environment where all colleagues are encouraged to provide input. Actively listen to team members' ideas, concerns, and feedback and incorporate their input into decision-making processes. Recognize and appreciate the contributions and well-being of colleagues.

  3. 3. Strive for guest/client satisfaction:

    Exhibits a deep understanding of the luxury hospitality landscape and guest expectations, ensuring that the guest experience consistently exceeds industry standards. Maintain product and service quality standards by conducting ongoing evaluations. Handle VIP Guests and understand international protocols for government officials and royalty. Monitor guest/client feedback, address concerns promptly, and implement improvements to optimize satisfaction.

  4. 4. Consistently deliver excellence:

    Demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of ownership group's investment objectives and formulates strategic business plans that align with those objectives; ensuring preservation and maximization of the hotel’s assets. Set high performance standards, lead by example, and drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality across all the hotel. Exhibits expertise in sales, marketing, and revenue management, driving the hotel's performance in the luxury hospitality market. Maximize financial performance, control costs, and execute marketing and operational activities that produce results meeting or exceeding the hotel's business plan. Recognize and reward outstanding performance and celebrate achievements within the organization.

  5. 5. Enable team success:

    Support the professional growth and development of colleagues through coaching, mentoring, and providing opportunities for learning. Encourage individuals to take on challenging assignments and stretch their capabilities. Provide regular feedback and guidance, recognizing achievements and offering constructive suggestions for improvement. Create a safe and empowering environment where individuals feel comfortable taking risks, expressing their ideas, and learning from failures. As applicable, brings experience in working with labor unions, maintaining constructive relationships and ensuring harmonious teamwork.

  6. 6. Create clarity:

    Articulates a clear and comprehensive vision for the hotel, aligning goals and objectives with ownership group's investment strategy. Effectively communicates organizational vision, goals, and expectations, fostering a shared sense of purpose and direction among team members. Demonstrates adeptness in overseeing renovation projects, maintaining transparency and open communication throughout the process. Addresses ambiguity and navigates complex situations with transparency, fostering an environment of clear direction and effective problem-solving.

  7. 7. Inspire for top performance:

    Lead with passion and integrity, motivate and inspire others to achieve their best. Market plans and ideas successfully, reducing key and complex ideas and messages to clear, memorable, and compelling statements. Embodies an entrepreneurial spirit, inspiring innovative thinking and fostering a culture that encourages taking calculated risks. Recognizes and rewards outstanding performance, cultivating an atmosphere of achievement and recognition. Promotes continuous development and growth, offering resources and guidance to nurture professional skills and talents. Champions a "speak-up" culture, creating an environment where diverse opinions are valued, and individual contributions are celebrated. Convince others, negotiate, debate, and find win-win solutions.

Additional Information

Prior experience in a luxury hotel General Manager position, in large hotel(s) (mandatory)

Strong educational background with professional qualifications and a continuous learning mindset.

Fluent in English and in Portuguese or Spanish (mandatory)

Experience in working in Latin America, preferably in Brazil (mandatory)

Proven track record of building a strong service, and quality culture

Strong people skills and a track record of fostering positive, inclusive, high-performing cultures.

Experience in managing owner relations.

Demonstrated leadership, organizational, and interpersonal skills.

Strategic thinker with excellent communication and presentation skills.

Displays a strong entrepreneurial spirit

Bottom-line oriented with a focus on quality guest service and team-building.

Creative and innovative mindset.

Ability to collaborate and work in a fast-paced environment.

Excellent sense of prioritization and time management.

Professional demeanor and strategic orientation.

Engaging, friendly, and charismatic with a natural ability to connect with guests.

Passionate about creating memorable experiences and turning moments into memories

# Monitor(a) de Operações - AquaRioRio de Janeiro - RJPresential1 PositionEffective - CLTHelperFull timeAo se juntar ao Grupo Cataratas, você fará parte de uma empresa que tem em seu DNA a sustentabilidade, a diversidade e a inovação, e que se esforça para deixar um legado duradouro de impacto positivo no mundo.Aqui não nos limitamos a simplesmente oferecer um emprego, mas sim a proporcionar uma experiência significativa e enriquecedora para nossos Embaixadores. Não é atoa que hoje somos reconhecidos como um excelente lugar para se trabalhar por nossos Embaixadores, certificados pela GPTW, FIA-UOL e Valor Carreira.Essa é uma oportunidade para atuar no Gexperience, o parque da Globo. O gex, como é popularmente conhecido, “nasceu” em São Paulo, viajou o País inteiro e agora chega no AquaRio. Com atrações adaptadas a cada localidade e em colaboração com afiliadas regionais, o projeto visa democratizar o acesso ao conteúdo da Globo, promovendo interatividade, tecnologia e valorização da cultura local.Como será o seu dia-a-dia (Responsabilidades):• Recepcionar e orientar visitantes no espaço, oferecendo um atendimento acolhedor e informações claras.• Monitorar o fluxo de público e colaborar para a organização do ambiente, garantindo a segurança e preservação dos equipamentos e instalações.• Interagir de forma ativa com o público, incentivando a participação nas atividades e apresentando o funcionamento das estações interativas.• Atender e esclarecer dúvidas com simpatia e proatividade, contribuindo para que cada visitante tenha uma experiência positiva e marcante.O que você precisa ter (Requisitos):• Desejavel experiência anterior com atendimento em grande fluxo.• Gosto por trabalhar com pessoas, sabendo lidar com diferentes perfis.• Facilidade de relacionamento interpessoal e trabalho em equipe.Local de trabalho:• AquaRio. Gamboa, Centro.Horário de trabalho e escala:• Escala 6x1, inclusive aos finais de semana e feriados.• 09:00 às 17:20.Vem causar muito impacto positivo conosco!### Requirements##### StudiesHigh School (2nd Degree)### BenefitsVale-refeiçãoSala de descansoMassoterapiaDesconto em farmáciasAuxílio funerárioSeguro de vidaAuxílio combustívelPlano de saúdeEstacionamentoWellhub/GympassEventos e comemorações abertos à famíliaPlano odontológicoAcompanhamento psicológicoAvaliação de desempenho anualDescontos de até 50% nos parquesAcompanhamento nutricionalParticipação nos resultadosVale-transporteLicença maternidade/paternidade estendidaReajuste por tempo de serviçoFolga de tempo de empresaFolga de aniversárioVale culturaSala de amamentaçãoSala de acolhimentoAuxílio crecheVale-alimentação### About Grupo CataratasDesde 1999, o Grupo Cataratas atua com excelência na gestão e operação de experiências transformadoras em parques e atrações turísticas, sendo a principal empresa de Turismo Sustentável do Brasil. Atualmente estamos com operações em sete parques, entre eles, os parques naturais, de vida animal e temáticos - Cataratas do Iguaçu, EcoNoronha, Paineiras-Corcovado, AquaRio, Marco das Três Fronteiras, BioParque do Rio e Jericoacoara, que impactam mais de 5,5 milhões de visitantes por ano. O próximo passo é a abertura do AquaFoz, que tem previsão de inauguração em 2025. O Grupo Cataratas, através de seus atrativos, busca criar e promover um legado duradouro de impacto positivo. Somos feitos de gente para gente. Cuidamos do bem-estar dos nossos embaixadores para poder ressignificar a relação das pessoas com a natureza por meio de experiências verdadeiramente transformadoras, proporcionando visitações que divertem e conscientizam ao mesmo tempo. Afinal, assim como a natureza, estamos em constante evolução. Atuamos através dos pilares de Educação, Pesquisa, Conservação e Entretenimento tendo a Sustentabilidade, Diversidade e Inovação como parte do nosso DNA.

title: MEDICO DO TRABALHO - HOSPITAL CARDOSO FONTES
description:
Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .

OHospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro.A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Promover e preservar a saúde dos colaboradores no ambiente de trabalho, por meio de ações de medicina preventiva, assistencial e ocupacional, conforme a legislação vigente e as normas da empresa.

Realizar exames médicos admissionais, periódicos, de retorno ao trabalho, mudança de função e demissionais conforme exigências da NR-7 (Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional – PCMSO);

Avaliar as condições de saúde dos colaboradores, identificando fatores de risco ocupacional;

Emitir e controlar atestados de saúde ocupacional (ASO);

Participar de programas de qualidade de vida e prevenção de doenças no ambiente de trabalho;

Analisar e acompanhar afastamentos médicos, atuando junto ao INSS e à perícia médica quando necessário;

Assessorar tecnicamente os setores da empresa quanto às ações de promoção e vigilância em saúde;

Apoiar a CIPA e demais comissões internas de saúde e segurança;

Trabalhar em conjunto com o Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho na identificação e mitigação de riscos à saúde;

Graduação completa em Medicina;

Especialização em Medicina do Trabalho (com título de especialista reconhecido pelo CRM);

Conhecimento da legislação trabalhista e normas regulamentadoras;

Habilidades em comunicação, ética, sigilo e trabalho em equipe.

Experiência de 6 meses na função.

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.

Local: Jacarepaguá/RJ

Escala: 30h semanais

Horário: a combinar

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção

  • Step 3: Avaliação 3 Avaliação

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectively nos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.
